hub.title: EX Control
hub.description: Each car adds itself the first time it connects: its readings, controls, location and live camera, together on one device per car. On the car, switch on Home Assistant and leave "Use the EX Control integration" on.

camera.title: EX Control live camera
camera.description: For a car whose app does not yet connect to this integration. The car sends its cameras here when you pick one on its Camera control. Use the same stream name as the car's Live camera settings.

old_mobile_app.title: {car} still has its old mobile app device

confirm.title: Remove the old device for {car}?
confirm.description:
{car} now reports through EX Control, so the mobile app device "{old}" no longer updates. Removing it also removes the template controls that one-tap setup put on it, and gives EX Control's entities their names back (sensor.geely_battery instead of sensor.geely_battery_2), so dashboards keep working where names match.

The hidden input helpers it used are left in place; delete them under Settings > Helpers if you like.
